scope: Local final text archive and exact export allowlist, before root closure commit/push; does not verify a new remote closure SHA or upgrade scientific verdicts.
closure_hash_definition: Every approved payload is pinned by path, byte count and SHA256 in allowedfiles.json. The manifest is scanned/copied separately; its own SHA is recorded in the private export receipt to avoid recursive self-hash.
exporter_prewrite_requirement: Scan all bytes and all target paths before any public write; export receipt must PASS before root final commit.
final_closure_commit_remote_check: To be performed and reported externally by root after committing/pushing.
